column3: そんな生き物が…何故ここに…？{w}{br}
column4: A creature like that… why is it here…?{w}{br}

column3: 学会で発表されている研究成果だと、とてもじゃないけどこれほど精巧な生物を作ることなんて不可能なはずね。{w}{br}
column4: {p}Going by research presented at conferences, making an organism this intricate should be quite impossible.{w}{br}

column3: だけど、現実に生物は存在し、人を襲っている…。{w}{br}
column4: And yet in reality the organism exists, and it's attacking people…{w}{br}

column3: 裏ではしっかり研究が進んでいた、ってことね。{w}{br}
column4: That, in secret, research had been well under way.{w}{br}

column3: クローン羊の誕生なんかで驚いてる場合じゃないわ。{p}
column4: This is no time to marvel at things like the birth of the cloned sheep.{p}

column3: そんな生物を相手に…するの？{w}{br}
column4: We're going to take on… that kind of organism?{w}{br}

column3: この生き物を相手に、私たちがとりうる最善の対策とはなにか。{w}{br}
column4: Against this creature, what is the best countermeasure open to us?{w}{br}

column3: サンプルのおかげでずいぶんと見えてきたもの。{w}{br}
column4: Thanks to the sample, much has become clear.{w}{br}

column3: 昆虫と哺乳類の利点を取り入れているとするなら、この生き物は卵生もしくは卵胎生。{p}
column4: If it has taken on the advantages of both insects and mammals,{p}then this creature is oviparous or ovoviviparous.{p}

column3: おそらく大量に生まれているはずよ。{w}{br}
column4: Most likely they've been born in huge numbers.{w}{br}

column3: 外骨格を持っている以上、脱皮か変態を行ってるはず。{w}{br}
column4: Given that it has an exoskeleton, it must molt or undergo metamorphosis.{w}{br}

column3: 例の大きいのが成虫だとすれば、いくつかの段階をふんでいるはずでしょうね。{p}
column4: If that big one is the adult, it has likely gone through several stages.{p}

column3: これが幼生体だとすると、最終的にサナギの段階へ進むはずよ。{w}{br}
column4: If this is the larva, it should eventually move on to the pupa stage.{w}{br}

column3: 弱点だとするなら、まずその状態がひとつ。{w}{br}
column4: If we're talking weak points, that state is one, to begin with.{w}{br}

column3: 考えたくないけど、その可能性はあるわね。{w}{br}
column4: I'd rather not think so, but it's possible.{w}{br}

column3: でも、結論を急いじゃダメ。{w}{br}
column4: But we mustn't be hasty in reaching a conclusion.{w}{br}

column3: まったく別の個体である可能性だって充分あるわ。{p}
column4: There's every chance they're entirely separate individuals, too.{p}

column3: ロッカーには何も入っていない。{p}
